O8t1fP1y1oo.description:
Pennsylvania: 1 Day in Philadelphia - Travel Vlog | What to Do, See, & Eat in Philly

Welcome to state #30 in our journey to all 50 states in 2021… Pennsylvania! For our time in the Keystone State, we spent one day exploring the state’s largest city, Philadelphia! As you probably know, Philadelphia is one of the most historically significant cities in the US, so we made sure to cram in as much of that history as possible during our visit. From visiting Independence Hall and standing in the room that the Declaration of Independence AND the US Constitution were written, to taking a historic walking tour where we visited the final resting place of Benjamin Franklin, to climbing the iconic steps of the Philadelphia Museum of Art that were made famous by the 1970/80’s “Rocky” movies, I’d say we fit in just about as much as humanly possible! Oh, and don’t worry, we didn’t leave the city without having one of the most iconic American foods… the Philly Cheesesteak!
